newsitem.title: USA: Cree Research says lawsuit has no merit.
newsitem.headline: Cree Research says lawsuit has no merit.

text.p: Cree Research Inc said on Wedneday that a purported class action suit filed against it on behalf of those who purchased Cree common stock between February 1 and July 2 is without merit.

"The company and its management have and will continue to be forthright with its investors in all matters," President and Chief Executive Neal Hunter said in a statement. "We are certain the suit is without merit and will defend the case vigorously."
The plaintiffs allege that Cree provided misleading statements concerning company plans to produce blue light-emitting diode chips.

These statements allowed directors and officers of the company to take advantage of an artificially inflated stock price by selling portions of their stock holding to the public, generating $3.7 million in proceeds, according to the suit.
